# Front differential locker options

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Replace standard spider gears with a LOKKA automatic differential locker and ensure 4x4 is disengaged before driving. [t121]

## Parts

- 205 front axle housing, optional: Recommended if pounding the truck hard to prevent breakage. [t121]
- LOKKA automatic differential locker [t121]

## Tips & gotchas

- The LOKKA functions as a 'lunchbox locker' that simply replaces the spider gears. [t121]
- It is less expensive than an ARB but may require more maintenance attention regarding oil condition. [t121]
- Consider upgrading to a 205 housing if planning aggressive trail use. [t121]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Using it in daily driving without disengaging the 4x4 system first. [t121]
